sources.title: Nature — Image integrity and standards
sources.section: Opening policy paragraphs; Electrophoretic gels and blots; Microscopy
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Requires faithful image processing, relevant disclosure, identifiable composites and controls, and unprocessed life-science gel/blot originals at final acceptance.
sources.ambiguity: The isolated microscopy line about grouping cells from multiple fields conflicts with surrounding restrictions. Do not turn it into an instruction to assemble an undisclosed field.
sources.retrieval_note: Full page retrieved with error=cookies_not_supported query.
sources.scope: Nature image-integrity policy; final raw gel requirement scoped to life-science papers

sources.title: Nature research figure guide — Image Integrity
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Prohibits generative AI in figures, including content-aware editing, and specifies boundaries, reuse labels and original gel information.
supports: no generative figure production by default
sources.scope_note: The prohibition is broader than data repair. Do not assume schematics or diagrams are exempt; unusual contexts need explicit editorial direction and current policy verification.
sources.scope: Flagship Nature research figures, image integrity and figure-generation restrictions

sources.title: Beyond Bar and Line Graphs: Time for a New Data Presentation Paradigm
sources.authors: Weissgerber TL, Milic NM, Winham SJ, Garovic VD
sources.section: Introduction; Figures 1–2; Recommendations for a New Data Presentation Paradigm
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Examples show distinct data distributions and pairing obscured by similar summaries; recommends displaying small continuous datasets more fully.
sources.scope_note: The systematic review concerns physiology journals and small continuous datasets. It does not establish a blanket ban on bars or lines, nor a Nature submission rule.
sources.scope: External scientific recommendation based on small continuous datasets and physiology research; not journal policy

sources.scope_note: Design guidance, not a flagship Nature requirement. Do not apply quantitative colour-map criteria indiscriminately to photographic colour or categorical labels.
